limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The theorem is specific to the displayed logarithmic radial weight; it does not classify general radial weights and does not assert surjectivity of the single-symbol eigenvalue map. A residual prior-art risk remains from older or non-indexed work on radial Toeplitz algebras for general moment spaces.
record_title: Norm saturation of radial Toeplitz quantization for a logarithmic Fock weight
